# model-call-haiku

Synthetic token counts. Haiku 4.5: 1200 × $1 + 300 × $5 + 2000 × $0.10 per million tokens =
$0.0029. Sonnet 5: 3000 × $2 + 500 × $10 + 4000 × $2.50 (5-minute cache write) per million =
$0.021. GBP at the synthetic rate 0.75. A model missing from the price table is refused, never
priced by guess.
